source_facts.fact: ros::spin() services the default queue; no concurrent FSM odometry queue in this node main

FSM odometry uses nh subscription; callback directly updates mm_state and yaw. Reject diagnostic reads that cache, while collision checks candidate trajectory. Synchronous reboundReplan blocks the default queue.
Dynamic prediction NodeHandle binds a separate callback queue and starts its own AsyncSpinner(1).
Runtime confirms Dynamic prediction callbacks use an isolated worker queue.
Kernel reference consists of x,y,yaw,v samples; original polynomial timestamps are not part of this C ABI input.
Projection associates measured/rollout state with reference geometry under active gear-phase scope.

current_source_comparison.scope: Read-only comparison of current src; no deployed binary or live hardware run inspected
current_source_comparison.conclusion: The mechanism can also occur in hardware software built from current src; not unique to the SIL harness. The measured 1.428 s lag and 9.73 cm displacement remain SIL-only evidence.
current_source_comparison.not_a_validated_fix: Replacing spin with a multithread spinner alone was not implemented or validated; shared state ownership and handoff time assumptions require separate reasoning.
